question: What happens when a worldly knowledge lineage is destroyed?
premises: A knowledge lineage accustomed to beginningless worldly life can be destroyed.
When it is destroyed, transcendent knowledge can take the place of another lineage.
That other lineage is a noble knowledge lineage not accustomed to worldly life.
inference: The destruction of worldly conditioning allows one to enter a transcendent knowledge lineage.
uncertainties: The optative 'śrayet' may express a general principle or a hypothetical transition.
plain_english: When that worldly knowledge lineage is destroyed, transcendent knowledge would take on the character of another lineage, namely a noble knowledge lineage not accustomed to worldly life.
